newsitem.title: USA: Seaman Furniture to go private.
newsitem.headline: Seaman Furniture to go private.

text.p: Seaman Furniture Co. Inc. said Thursday it plans to sell the remaining 20 percent of its stock to an investment group, completing its transition to a privately held company.

It said SFC Merger Co., the investment group, will buy the remaining stock for $25.05 a share, for a total of over $22 million. SFC already holds 80 percent of Seaman's 4.54 million shares outstanding.
SFC Merger includes M.D. Sass Associates Inc., T. Rowe Price Recovery Fund LP and Carl Marks Management Co. LP.
The company said it expects a special meeting of stockholders for a vote on the merger in October.
A spokeswoman said there would be no visible changes to the company, "execpt it'll be a private company."
Seaman is a specialty retailer of furniture, with 41 stores in New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Connecticut and Ohio.
Seaman's stock was up $2 at $24.25 in morning trading on Nasdaq, on volume of 3,200 shares.
